places.quote: we were to return to London on the morrow
places.note: Setting is return and drive to London; Dickens's London.

places.quote: His Majesty’s High Court of King’s Bench at Westminster
places.note: Named as the seat of the court, not as a visited location.

places.quote: We drove away, out of town, to the churchyard at Hornsey.
places.note: Then a village outside the metropolis.

places.quote: we rode back to her little cottage at Highgate
places.note: Then a village in Middlesex, outside the metropolis.

places.quote: He died the night before we went to Canterbury?
places.note: Also the place of the Micawbers' letter heading.
